import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t, rx, ry;
    static String[] lab, sci;
    static int[][][][][] mem;
    static int[][] dist;
    static int[][] vis;
    static List<List<Integer>> cap;
    static List<Integer> par;
    static final int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};

    static boolean good(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n && 0 <= y && y < n && lab[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && lab[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }

    static void pre() {
        dist = new int[n][n];
        vis = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
            Arrays.fill(vis[i], 0);
        }
        dist[rx][ry] = 0;
        vis[rx][ry] = 1;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(rx * n + ry);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            int x = v / n;
            int y = v % n;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k];
                int ny = y + dy[k];
                if (good(nx, ny) && vis[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                    q.add(nx * n + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean canReach(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, int ptr) {
        if (ptr > t) return false;
        if (mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] != -1) return mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] == 1;
        if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) {
            boolean res = dist[x0][y0] >= ptr;
            mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] = res ? 1 : 0;
            return res;
        }
        if (dist[x0][y0] <= ptr) {
            mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] = 0;
            return false;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int nx = x0 + dx[k];
            int ny = y0 + dy[k];
            if (good(nx, ny) && canReach(nx, ny, x1, y1, ptr + 1)) {
                mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] = 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        mem[x0][y0][x1][y1][ptr] = 0;
        return false;
    }

    static boolean fml(int s, int t) {
        Collections.fill(par, -1);
        par.set(s, -2);
        Queue<Integer> qu = new LinkedList<>();
        qu.add(s);
        while (!qu.isEmpty()) {
            int v = qu.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < cap.size(); i++) {
                if (par.get(i) == -1 && cap.get(v).get(i) > 0) {
                    par.set(i, v);
                    qu.add(i);
                }
            }
        }
        return par.get(t) != -1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        sci = new String[n];
        lab = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) sci[i] = sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) lab[i] = sc.nextLine();

        List<int[]> pos = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> lc = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> scList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = sci[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    pos.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    lc.add(lab[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    scList.add(c - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        int m = pos.size();
        cap = new ArrayList<>(2 * m + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * m + 2; i++) {
            cap.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(2 * m + 2, 0)));
        }
        par = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(2 * m + 2, -1));

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            cap.get(0).set(i + 1, scList.get(i));
            cap.get(m + 1 + i).set(2 * m + 1, lc.get(i));
        }

        pre();
        mem = new int[12][12][12][12][62];
        for (int a = 0; a < 12; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 12; b++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < 12; c++) {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 12; d++) {
                        Arrays.fill(mem[a][b][c][d], -1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                if (canReach(pos.get(i)[0], pos.get(i)[1], pos.get(j)[0], pos.get(j)[1], 0)) {
                    cap.get(i + 1).set(m + 1 + j, 1000);
                }
            }
        }

        int flow = 0;
        while (fml(0, 2 * m + 1)) {
            int cur = 2 * m + 1;
            int nflow = 1000000;
            while (par.get(cur) >= 0) {
                nflow = Math.min(nflow, cap.get(par.get(cur)).get(cur));
                cur = par.get(cur);
            }
            cur = 2 * m + 1;
            while (par.get(cur) >= 0) {
                int p = par.get(cur);
                cap.get(p).set(cur, cap.get(p).get(cur) - nflow);
                cap.get(cur).set(p, cap.get(cur).get(p) + nflow);
                cur = p;
            }
            flow += nflow;
        }

        System.out.println(flow);
        sc.close();
    }
}
